Chapter 6636: That Simple

Chapter 6636: That Simple

Light God had an ominous feeling with Sixth-sense’s appearance during this crucial moment.

“It’s time for us to cooperate.” Sixth-sense gazed at him again, clearly no longer himself. His eyes were as deep as a bottomless abyss.

This eerie feeling was seen on another cultivator previously - Primal Yin Immortal Ghost.

“We will not.” Light God said, aware that the guy was talking to Bao Pu.

He guarded his dao heart and mind, afraid of Bao Pu’s awakening.

“Brother, hiding is useless. Even if no one kills you, your dao is incomplete and you will die either way.” Sixth-sense’s voice appeared inside his head.

“You need someone to guide you, to help you.” The voice continued: “Only we can mend your grand dao. We’re the only ones who can accept and forgive you, granting you your dream. Your immortality started with a primordial immortal, and we primordial immortals can help you better than anyone.”

Light God couldn’t resist since his opponent was an ancient immortal.

He started chanting and repeating in his mind: “I am me, Light God, leave!”

“Crackle!” Meanwhile, Calamities became frenzied and set his tribulations free again.

“Time does not wait for us.” Light God’s attempt at filling his mind with holy power couldn’t chase the foreign voice away.

“Help me now and we will fix your grand dao and take you to a primordial item, you will become one of us.” The voice continued.

Light God froze and so did his mind. He felt himself stiffening and became alarmed: “Get out!”

Unfortunately, it was too late. Something hidden deep in his true fate finally surfaced.

“The plan?” A low voice echoed in his mind.

He hadn’t lost consciousness but his body no longer obeyed him. Although he believed Li Qiye, he still held onto hope until now.

He was truly a part of Bao Pu - kindness. He was separated and protected by the blessing of the three immortals, unaware of Bao Pu hiding deep in his true fate.

“You take over World Seal, I will destroy Calamities.” Sixth-sense answered.

“It’s that simple?” Bao Pu asked.

“That simple.” Sixth-sense responded.

“Why Calamities?” Bao Pu was tempted by the offer.

“That’s our business.” Sixth-sense said.

Bao Pu hesitated because no one could find his true body. Many wanted to kill him and given his current power, they could do so. He naturally wanted to fix his dao to stop becoming an abomination. However, no method was available.

However, this immortal from Fiendish Ground could help him become a true primordial immortal. This was his dream all along.

Alas, he wouldn’t be able to hide again once exposed because he had run out of resources.

“It’s over if you hesitate, there won’t be another opportunity.” The voice said: “Your only bridge was Xian Chengtian who is dead now, no one else will trust you, hence the end of any more resources. We are your only hope.”

“...” Bao Pu hesitated for a second before responding: “Very well.”

Supreme Heaven didn’t trust him, neither did Zhan Sansheng. These two immortals certainly didn’t either but now, they actively made a deal.

Light God wanted to scream but nothing came out.

“Now.” Sixth-sense said.

Light God flickered like a spirit and instantly appeared behind World Seal.

“Buzz.” Immortal light scattered behind him, summoning a figure merging with Light God. He extended his hand, channeling power into World Seal.

Its power surged dramatically once controlled by an immortal. The pressure struck Calamities and forced all the lightning bolts back, fully extinguishing him.

All along, his tribulations were ceaseless and aggressive. When overlords and immortals drew near, their personal tribulation could descend and reduce them to ashes.
